ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure, there are three input terminals connected to a rectangular function block; the upper input is labeled A, the middle input is labeled B, and beside the lower input there is a constant “1”, which is connected to the EN enable terminal inside the block. Inside the rectangular block, it is labeled “≥1”. On the right side there is an output terminal, labeled Y. Reasoning: The EN terminal is connected to the constant 1, indicating that this function block is enabled, so it works normally according to the logic inside the block. “≥1” indicates that when at least one of the inputs is 1, the output is 1. For the two logic inputs A and B, this is exactly the OR operation. Therefore the output is Y = A + B.
